== Selling==
Units sell for 25% of their deployment cost and upgrades.

==Trivia ==
*Alongside [[Falcon (Feather Strike)|Falcon]], they're the second and third units respectively to be buffed during their debut, after [[Paradox (Divine Sight)|Paradox]].
*His shiny is his costume after the explosion that happened in Season 6.
*Due to My Hero Academia units being changed up shortly before Anime Adventures closed along side Gamefam releasing an official My Hero Academia game, players have speculated that this unit is the reason that Anime Adventures got closed down and earned the nickname "AA killer". This has not been confirmed.
